classifiedFinding.title: Contract publishes no cumulative-distribution audit trail

classification.assetImpact: None. No on-chain way to verify the linear-depletion intent vs realized distribution.
attackPath: 1. Auditors / integrators want to verify rewards distributed == rewards funded over a window.
2. No cumulative counters or summary events exist; verification requires log-scraping every transfer.

classifiedFinding.justification: Observability gap. Recommend cumulative counters (totalPhUSDMinted, totalStableDistributed) and a periodic summary event. Pure QA.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-low. Classifier agrees: QA.
